transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on almost every day for about two years and five months.
Have you had periods of feeling down or depressed for most of the day, nearly every day, for two years or more?
Yes, absolutely. I've been feeling down and depressed nearly every day, for most of the day. It has been going on continuously like this for about two years and five months now.
During this time, have you consistently lost interest or pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?
No, I haven't really noticed a significant loss of interest in my usual activities. I'm not quite sure, but I think my interest in things has stayed mostly the same despite how down I feel.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over these two years, such as eating much more or much less than usual?

Yes, I have noticed quite a few changes in both my appetite and weight over this period. I've gone through phases where I have almost no appetite and lose a lot of weight, and other times where my appetite increases significantly and I end up gaining weight.
Have you experienced ongoing problems with sleep, such as trouble falling asleep, staying asleep, or sleeping too much?

Yes, my sleep has been really messed up. I often have trouble falling asleep, wake up constantly throughout the night, or wake up too early and can't drift off again. At other times, I find myself sleeping for excessively long periods.
Have you frequently felt tired or lacked energy during this period, even when you get enough rest?

Yes, I feel constantly exhausted and completely lack the energy to get through my day. Even when I manage to get what should be enough sleep, it never feels refreshing and I still wake up feeling tired. It's like a heavy, chronic fatigue that just won't go away.
Have you often felt low self-worth or excessive guilt during this time, even when there's no clear reason for it?
No, I haven't really experienced those specific feelings. Even though my mood is very low, I don't find myself feeling guilty or having low self-worth.
When you feel down or sad, would you describe your mood as more of a chronic low-grade sadness, or have there been times when it felt more severe, like a deep hopelessness or emptiness?

I actually experience both. I have a continuous, chronic gloomy sadness that has been going on for over two years, but I also frequently feel a deep, hollow sense of inner emptiness and emotional numbness where I feel no emotion at all.

During the times when your sadness felt more intense, did these periods last for at least two weeks and include symptoms like poor concentration, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of death or suicide?

While my sadness has definitely been ongoing for over two years, I haven't experienced those specific symptoms. I don't have issues with concentration, feelings of worthlessness, or any thoughts of death.
